name: Season Development
author: AlbaMD
description: AI teams develop their cars through a career season: upgrade packages that work, half work or fail, big steps in the early and summer upgrade windows, teams that stop to focus on next year, and a paddock report at Team HQ before every round. Your own car is never touched. Offline only.

options.label: AI season development
options.description: Apply each AI team's development to its cars in career sessions.

options.label: Strength
options.description: How much a development step changes the car, in percent of the default.

options.label: Upgrade frequency
options.description: How often teams bring upgrade packages.

options.label: Packages that fail
options.description: How often an upgrade doesn't work and has to be rolled back.

options.label: Develop your team-mate's car
options.description: Off: your team develops only through the game's own R&D.

options.label: Paddock report
options.description: The upgrades popup at Team HQ before each round.

options.label: Verbose log
options.description: Write every car's scales and every news line to swofty/loader.log.
